$comment: The $id path names the marvel-owned adapter-event seam, distinct from the director envelope family (director/envelope): the envelope is agent speech, this is the adapter telemetry frame that gets lifted into an envelope. Same $id base https://schema.arcaven.com (operator ruling D8). SOURCE OF TRUTH IS GO, NOT THIS SCHEMA. internal/runtime/events/events.go is authoritative for the marvel runtime adapter event vocabulary; this schema is its wire twin, so a Rust consumer (beadle) generates from one shape and cannot drift from the Go emitter (finding-034). Per the architect ruling 2026-09-13 the source of truth flips to schema-first only on a second PRODUCER of these events, never a consumer. Behaviors events.go carries that a schema cannot express, and which stay hand-written in Go: Occupancy() and the additive/subsumptive Layout, TotalMismatch(), AdditiveConfirmed(), the SeqAssigner, and the 64 KiB Truncate/MaxSummaryBytes summary discipline. The $id base is https://schema.arcaven.com (operator ruling D8) and need not resolve. This is the adapter event seam; it is DISTINCT from the director envelope (agent speech) and from the daemon control-plane ring. The lift from an event to an envelope is the seam: this twin invents no envelope field. Evolution: the frame is closed and a breaking change to it bumps schema_version; per-kind data payloads grow additively (data objects are lenient) and additive growth does NOT bump schema_version.
title: Director Adapter Event
description: The normalized event frame every marvel runtime adapter emits after digesting a harness-specific telemetry stream. The v1 vocabulary is closed to twelve kinds; an unknown vendor event maps to the error kind with data.kind = unmapped rather than being dropped.

schema_version.description: Event-frame schema version. Bumped only for breaking changes to this top-level frame; additive changes to per-kind data do not bump it. Integer per the session-029 rule.

event.$comment: Closed v1 vocabulary. This enum MUST equal the events.Kind constant set in events.go both ways; a drift-guard test fails on either-direction divergence.
event.description: The event kind. Selects the shape of data.

seq.description: Monotonic per-stream sequence, starting at 1. Consumers detect gaps on it.

ts.description: Event time. RFC3339; the pattern enforces it without format-assertion mode.

agent_id.description: The roster address, same closed class as the envelope sender.agent_id (R-76). Optional on an event; present once marvel names the session.

workspace.description: The workspace, same closed class as the envelope. Optional.

harness.$comment: Open string, not an enum: a new adapter must not require a schema bump. Known values: claude, codex, opencode, forestage, simulator, generic.
harness.description: The harness the emitting adapter fronts.

harness_session_id.description: The harness's own session id, when it exposes one. Optional.

data.description: The per-kind payload. Its shape is selected by event (see the allOf below). Lenient by design: per-kind fields grow additively without bumping schema_version.

raw.$comment: The unparsed vendor event (json.RawMessage in Go). Any JSON value; retained for diagnostics and re-derivation. Optional.
raw.description: The original vendor event payload, verbatim.

otel_traceparent.description: W3C Trace Context traceparent (00-<trace-id>-<span-id>-<flags>). Empty or absent when not tracing.

usage.$comment: The shared token/cost shape on turn and session events. Do not sum token classes to get occupancy; that is Occupancy() in Go, which applies Layout.

requestUsage.$comment: One API request's token accounting as the harness reported it. Fields are carried as the harness names them and are not pre-interpreted; Occupancy()/Layout, TotalMismatch(), and AdditiveConfirmed() in Go interpret them. Lenient.

metering.$comment: Accounting a harness reports at session end. Every field optional; a harness reporting none leaves metering absent so a consumer can tell not-reported from zero.

sessionEndedData.$comment: exit_code 0 is success; non-zero lifts to an alert per the lift contract.

messageData.$comment: text is bounded by the 64 KiB Truncate discipline in Go.

toolCallData.$comment: call_id correlates with the matching tool.result. input is a bounded summary of any JSON shape.

toolResultData.$comment: ok is !is_error in the vendor stream. output is a bounded summary of any JSON shape.

permissionRequestedData.$comment: The escalation event: marvel surfaces it to a supervisor per the lift contract.

errorData.$comment: Vendor error or adapter-internal problem. kind is one of unmapped, parse, transport, or a harness-specific tag.
